# External IsoGraph validation

This directory is reserved for evidence whose truth conditions or oracle are independent of the IsoGraph project-controlled qualification campaign.

## Suitable external targets

Examples include:

- established mathematical structures/results with independently checkable expected relations;
- independently specified programming-language or protocol semantics;
- public grammars/corpora with external ground truth;
- proof obligations checked by a named mechanical proof/checking system;
- third-party reconstruction or reproduction performed without project-directed scoring authority.

A fresh LLM, different model/provider, cold prompt, hidden packet, or blind verifier is still internal qualification when the project controls the task/oracle/scoring campaign.

## Minimum packet

Preserve:

- external source/oracle and immutable version/reference;
- exact IsoGraph Core/module revisions;
- exact represented input and comparison scope;
- expected external fact or falsifier;
- raw IsoGraph representation and output;
- checker/scorer/evaluator identity and version;
- all residuals, unknowns, mismatches, and rejected cases;
- whether any project-directed intervention occurred after the packet was frozen.

## Status

No general external validation is created by this scaffold itself. Historical qualification artifacts retain their recorded dispositions.
